properties.description: An Actions deploy of site/ to GitHub Pages, on each push to main that touches site/, the workflow or tools/site_counts.py, and on each v* release tag. It checks out every tag (fetch-depth 0) and writes one file, site/counts.json, with tools/site_counts.py: reflow2's own design counted at each release, for the home page's "It adds up". Nothing else is built (2026-10-13).
properties.name: .github/workflows/pages.yml — publishes site/ to GitHub Pages
